info.name: SSM Customer API
info.description: SSM mobile API for the **Customer** app. Auth: Passport bearer token from `/auth/sign-up` or `/auth/login`. Import together with `SSM_LOCAL.postman_environment.json`. See docs/SSM_CUSTOMER_API_GUIDE.md.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Passport bearer token. `POST /auth/sign-up` and `POST /auth/login` both return `{ token }`. Business validation errors on the legacy auth controllers use HTTP 403; wrong credentials use 401. Auth routes are throttled (10 per minute per IP, HTTP 429).

item.name: 07 Live Tracking & Delivery OTP
item.description: SSM REST tracking. The response is state-aware: while the canonical status is `driver_accepted`, `picked_up` or `out_for_delivery` the assigned Driver and latest location are returned; in every other state (including after delivery) `driver` and `location` are `null`.

exec: try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { json = null; }
pm.test('tracking_allowed matches the canonical status', function () { pm.expect(json.tracking_allowed).to.eql(live); });

pm.test('Driver/location only while trackable', function () { if (live) { pm.expect(json.driver).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json.driver).to.have.all.keys('id', 'name'); } else { pm.expect(json.driver).to.eql(null); pm.expect(json.location).to.eql(null); } });
pm.test('Driver phone/token are never returned', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(json)).to.not.match(/phone|auth_token|fcm/); });

request.description: Available only while the Order is out for delivery (HTTP 200 with `delivery_otp`); otherwise HTTP 409 `otp-not-available`. The customer shows the code to the Driver. Throttled 5/min.

exec: try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { json = null; }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('OTP challenge returned', function () { pm.expect(json.delivery_otp).to.include.keys('challenge_id', 'otp', 'expires_at'); pm.expect(json.delivery_otp.otp).to.match(/^[0-9]{6}$/); pm.environment.set('delivery_otp', json.delivery_otp.otp); }); }

item.name: 11 Parcels
item.description: Warehouse parcels created by admins and delivered by SSM Drivers. Customer delivery fee is always 0.00 SAR. Parcels are matched to the customer by `customer_id` or recipient phone.

exec: try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { json = null; }
const prepaid = json.data.find(p => p.payment_type === 'PREPAID'); const cod = json.data.find(p => p.payment_type === 'COD');
if (prepaid) pm.environment.set('parcel_id', prepaid.id); if (cod) pm.environment.set('parcel_cod_id', cod.id);
